A [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] served as a '''Rebel contact''' on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], this Rebel agent was based in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]], on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:EDR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, she was in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the city of Coronet when she met a group of Rebel spacers, sent to help her by a bartender from [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Hence, she had an important mission for this Rebel, which involved acquiring a historical disk which she needed for a report she was writing. The Rebel had the choice to either slay a number of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] foes for the disk, or meet up with a commoner in the [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] cantina. Ultimately, the spacers acquired the disk. The Rebel contact then sent the Rebel spacers to meet up with a Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spy]] named [[Tellulon]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG:EDR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWG_rebel_scout_female_Template.jpg|300px|thumb|Possible depictions of the Rebel contact]]
The Rebel contact appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EDR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rebel contact was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref>

During the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] live event from June 29 to [[July 11]], 2005,<ref name="FF">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2005)}}</ref> she could be found in Coronet and was part of a quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Empire Day Revealed|Empire Day Revealed]]," which would send players on an important mission throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG:EDR" /> After the live event ended, the Rebel contact never reappeared in the game, since the Empire Day event was discontinued until its complete overhaul in [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2008">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>

Since the Rebel contact spawned under the generic "rebel_scout_female" template utilizing three different Interchange File Formats, her appearance was randomized under one of three possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset. Nevertheless, the Rebel contact systematically appeared as a female.<ref name="SWG:EDR" />
